title: Global solutions for the sensors placement problem via weakly convex optimization
summary: We address the problem of optimally placing a limited number of sensors to reconstruct high-dimensional signals without knowledge of the underlying dynamics. The task is formulated as a nonconvex combinatorial optimisation problem and recast as a weakly convex constrained projection problem. This reformulation allows us to compute $\varepsilon$-global solutions using the Inexact Cutting Sphere algorithm.
